sources.role: derived fixed-window statistics on the same historical trace
limits and reproduced parser defects; not an independent production capture

historical_capture.target_architecture: one pool per verified selected hardware cluster, independent of historical pool count

metric_definitions.mean_oncpu_equivalents: matched running-interval duration sum divided by the same 10 s window; logical-CPU time equivalent, not physical-core throughput or target-96-CPU utilization
metric_definitions.observed_demand_equivalents: matched on-CPU time plus retained closed wake/re-runnable waiting time, divided by the same window; incomplete observed demand, not complete runnable-state reconstruction
metric_definitions.peak_1ms_oncpu_equivalents: maximum matched on-CPU duration sum / 1 ms across trace-anchored fixed buckets
metric_definitions.peak_1ms_unique_oncpu_tids: maximum number of distinct mapped TIDs with matched on-CPU overlap in one 1 ms bucket; exact set cardinality, not simultaneous running or Folly callback I
metric_definitions.waking: sched_waking attempt count in each bucket; not callback/request count
metric_definitions.wake_to_run_p99_ms: approximate quantile over retained closed wakeup-to-run samples; not all wakes and not request latency
metric_definitions.runnable_switch_to_run_p99_ms: approximate quantile over retained runnable switch-out-to-next-run samples; not request latency

same_window_pool_sum.warning: sum pools within each common time bucket before taking maximum; on-CPU and observed-demand maxima need not occur in the same bucket

concentration_from_1ms_fixed_buckets.high_service_definition: on-CPU equivalent > 2 times that pool's complete-window mean
concentration_from_1ms_fixed_buckets.warning: thresholds are pool-specific descriptive service thresholds, not common N>16 overload or runtime migration thresholds; fixed-bucket runs have boundary/censoring limits

do_not_use_as_calibration: 0.85 ms inferred from unspecified active N / wake rate is not operator CPU demand
1266 overload segments and 92 percent self-healing were not reproduced from available artifacts
3 ms / 0.9 C / 0.75 C / 2 C persistent-pressure thresholds are unvalidated candidates
windowed unique-onCPU is not instantaneous active callback I
historical four unbound pools do not validate target cluster binding
unknown or invalid intervals must not be silently filled with idle
the four per-pool maxima must not be summed as a concurrent peak
r and interval estimates do not establish cache benefits, causality, or production latency gains

chart_recommendation.primary: paired bars: per-pool mean vs 1 ms peak matched on-CPU equivalents, with historical-unbound caption
chart_recommendation.secondary: correlation range plot for three metric pairs at 1 and 10 ms; no inferred samples, error bars, or causal wording
chart_recommendation.avoid: do not graph an invented time series, synthetic request arrivals, instantaneous active N, or 3 ms state machine as measured real data
